paragraphs.text: The The Official Starter Game Strategy Guide explains the rules to the 1999 Starter edition of Magic: The Gathering . It is a softcover paperback with 94 pages, written by Cory Herndon , editor of The Duelist , and published by Wizards of the Coast on September 7, 1999.
The book features an overview of the set with reproductions of all the cards and hints on successful strategies for play and deck construction .
Cory Herndon, Industry Editor for Duelist Magazine, provides tips to help players get the most from the Magic: The Gathering Starter game.
Make the most out of preconstructed decks
Get color reprints of the Starter set cards
Learn how to build your first dek.
